seasonStart.subject: 🏒 New Extraliga Season Faces Off Sep 15!
seasonStart.title: New season incoming, {username}!
seasonStart.message:
The Czech and Slovak Extraliga both drop the puck on September 15. Sharpen your skates and join us for a shot at the top of the leaderboard.

We've also tweaked the rules a bit: 3 points now only require picking the correct winner and being off by just one goal from the final score — the goal difference no longer has to match exactly.

Got an idea or feedback? Drop us a note in the Feedback section, we read everything.
seasonStart.footer:
See you in the arena!
SLAPSHOT CLUB • 2026
